no_policy_groups_desc: Policy groups let you route uploads across one or more storage policies.
policy_group_invalid_assignment: The current policy group assignment is unavailable. Choose another active group or this user's uploads will fail.
policy_group_no_assignable_groups: No assignable policy groups are available yet. Create an enabled group with at least one rule first.
policy_group_page_desc: Configure upload admission rules and storage routing.
policy_group_not_found: This policy group does not exist or has been deleted.
policy_group_rules_desc: Rules are checked in order and the first match decides where the file goes; if nothing matches, the upload is rejected.
policy_group_policy_search_placeholder: Filter by policy name, ID, or driver...
policy_group_no_filtered_policies: No policies match the current filter.
policy_group_enabled_desc: A disabled group cannot be assigned to users or teams; existing assignments keep working.
policy_group_default_desc: Automatically assigned to new users at registration; only one default group exists.
policy_group_migration_desc: Move every user and team currently bound to the source group into another policy group.
policy_group_migration_hint: This only updates users' and teams' policy_group_id values. It does not move stored objects.
policy_group_migration_target_required: Choose a target policy group first.
policy_group_migration_same_group_invali: The target group must be different from the source group.
policy_group_migration_unavailable: Create another policy group before using migration.
policy_group_migration_success: Moved {{users}} users and {{teams}} teams from {{source}} to {{target}} ({{total}} bindings total).
delete_policy_group_desc: This will remove the group and its routing rules. Migrate assigned users and teams first, including for the last default group; deleting it reopens storage setup without clearing bindings.
policy_group_default_requires_enabled: A default policy group must remain enabled.
policy_group_rule_required: At least one routing rule is required.
policy_group_rule_policy_required: Every target must select a storage policy.
policy_group_rule_policy_duplicate: A policy cannot be the primary target of multiple rules.
policy_group_rule_target_required: Each rule needs at least one storage target.
policy_group_rule_target_duplicate: A policy cannot appear twice in the same rule.
policy_group_target_weight_invalid: Weight must be a positive integer.
policy_group_rule_size_invalid: File size limits must be valid non-negative numbers.
policy_group_rule_range_invalid: The max file size must be greater than the min file size.
policy_group_no_policies_available: Create at least one storage policy before creating a policy group.
policy_group_admission_desc: Any condition left empty is unrestricted.
policy_group_allowed_extensions_desc: Comma-separated; once set, only these extensions are accepted.
policy_group_denied_extensions_desc: Takes precedence over the allow list.
policy_group_admission_max_size_desc: Files larger than this cannot be uploaded.
policy_group_execution_automatic_desc: Prefer direct client-to-storage uploads; fall back to server upload when unsupported.
policy_group_execution_server_stream_des: Uploads are received and relayed by the server, consuming its bandwidth; client-direct storage strategies are overridden for this upload.
policy_group_allowed_categories_desc: Leave all unchecked for no restriction.
policy_group_denied_categories_desc: Takes precedence over the allow list.
policy_group_categories_help_intro: The system classifies files automatically by extension and MIME type — nothing to tag by hand.
policy_group_category_examples_image: jpg, png, gif, webp, svg, heic, raw…
policy_group_category_examples_video: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, avi, flv…
policy_group_category_examples_document: pdf, txt, md, doc, docx, epub…
policy_group_category_examples_code: js, ts, py, rs, go, json, sh…
policy_group_category_examples_other: Anything that matches none of the above
policy_group_simulator_size_invalid: File size must be a valid non-negative number.
policy_group_simulator_folder_policy_inv: Choose a valid folder policy override.
